title: qos_contention.dem header claims pipe 0 is oversubscribed ~2.4x; the catalog math yields ~4x
evidence: demos/qos_contention.dem:2-4 "# contention drop ladder (E7/E9). Pipe 0 (res 0 -> router 1) is oversubscribed / # ~2.4x with two classes the PLAYER categorized (canon 2026-08-12 — nothing / # auto-assigns): email -> Best-effort, streaming -> Express. A ~25ms burst"; demos/qos_contention.dem:22-25 "at 500ms spawn 0 2 email / at 525ms spawn 2 0 streaming / at 550ms spawn 0 2 email / at 575ms spawn 2 0 streaming"; data/balance.json "logic_hz": 20, "packet_bandwidth": 30; data/pipe_tiers.json standard "capacity_units": 15. lower_spawns (harness/run.odin) ticks = floor(at_ms*hz/1000), so 500ms and 525ms both land on tick 10: 2 spawns/tick = 60 units/tick demand vs 15 units/tick capacity = 4x (6x if streaming's bandwidth_demand 2 applied, which the spec's Never list says stays unused).
detail: The launchable's documented ratio is '~2.4x'; from the actual catalogs + spawn cadence the pipe is oversubscribed ~4x. The demo is still genuinely oversubscribed (BE-first drops + lane-ordered queue hold), so only the header claim is inaccurate.
recommended_fix: Correct the header comment to 'oversubscribed ~4x' (2 spawns/tick x 30 units vs 15 units/tick standard capacity), or document the ratio's basis.

title: load_demo_replay leaks the demo nodes/draws/spawns dynamic arrays
evidence: harness/run.odin:385-396 "for n in demo.nodes { append(&cfg.nodes, n) } / for s in demo.spawns { append(&cfg.spawns, s) } / cfg.session.goal = demo.win_goal / cfg.session.cap_ms = demo.lose_cap_ms / delete(demo.demolishes) // r1 note: the sibling loaders leaked this too / delete(demo.emphasis)   // 3.2 / delete(demo.lanes)      // 3.2 / delete(demo.captures)" — no delete(demo.nodes), delete(demo.draws), or delete(demo.spawns). parse_demo (harness/demo.odin) allocates them with make([dynamic]..., context.allocator); their string members are transferred to cfg (freed by demo_replay_destroy), but the three array buffers themselves are never freed on the run_replay/drift paths.
detail: The PR's r1 leak fix in this function freed demolishes/emphasis/lanes/captures but not the nodes/draws/spawns arrays; each load_demo_replay call leaks three dynamic-array buffers. Harness CLI only, small per-invocation leak.
recommended_fix: Add delete(demo.nodes), delete(demo.draws), delete(demo.spawns) beside the sibling deletes in load_demo_replay (array buffers only — cfg owns the cloned strings).
